decision: Retain the frozen v7 runtime after the full retrospective rerun and targeted independent audits.
failures_preserved: v5 B22 partial: unsupported negative; differing secondary pass and focused adjudication retained
v6 B21 fail: wrong subtotal and propagated quantities; run stopped at 27 actual responses
limitations: All final prompts are previously exposed regression cases.
Scores are model judgments, not human comprehension measurements.
The v4 baseline already passed all 60 long prompts; these results do not establish universal superiority.
The benchmark injects all references; native selective loading and universal IDE activation are not tested.
stop_reason: All primary final answers pass the registered semantic rubric, critical failure cases were checked again independently, and remaining recorded issues are a readable formatting defect and explicit answer-key qualifications. Preserve those limits rather than silently repairing outputs.
